explication: Koharu is a local-first manga translation desktop application. A user imports manga pages or archives, selects processing stages and models, then runs detection, OCR, translation, and inpainting; results are committed to a scene/project, reviewed on the canvas, and exported as images or layered PSD. The sampled code directly confirms desktop initialization, pipeline execution, translator construction, runtime resource monitoring, provider calls, and canvas resource activation. Some command-to-storage wiring is represented at subsystem level because those implementations were not sampled.
